interpretation: The frozen gate excludes clear regressions in mandatory claims even when aggregate pass count improves. Only eligible candidates can receive a repeat.
criterion_corrections: One of the portal or people-help routes is sufficient; removing a mistaken second-route omission does not change the partial verdict.
measurement_limitations: DEV-FU-10 frozen claim asks for counseling/formal-report distinction beyond merely rejecting the false premise. Preserve the predeclared score but do not overstate practical improvement.
Protection or contact method may permit alternatives; the strict candidate independently omits three other required reporting fields.
One generation repeat does not measure stable degradation or establish a general prompt ranking.
